english_translations.sahih_international: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands
english_translations.pickthall: Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: (All) these transgressed beyond bounds in the lands,
english_translations.shakir: Who committed inordinacy in the cities,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: led rebellious lives,
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Who did transgress beyond bounds in the lands (in the disobedience of Allah).
english_translations.arberry: who all were insolent in the land

ayahs.translation_bn: আর সেখানে বহু বিপর্যয় সৃষ্টি করেছিল।
ayahs.translation_en: And increased therein the corruption.
ayahs.conventional_en: And increased therein the corruption.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর সেখানে বহু বিপর্যয় সৃষ্টি করেছিল।

ayahs.meta_en: Exponential Multiplication of Corruption and Systemic Ruin
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ف-س-দ (f-s-d): systemic decay, entropy in civilization.

english_translations.pickthall: And multiplied iniquity therein?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And heaped therein mischief (on mischief).
english_translations.shakir: So they made great mischief therein?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: and spread much corruption in the land.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And made therein much mischief.
english_translations.arberry: and worked much corruption therein?

ayahs.translation_bn: অতঃপর তোমার প্রতিপালক তাদের উপর শাস্তির চাবুক হানলেন
ayahs.translation_en: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
ayahs.conventional_en: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
ayahs.conventional_bn: অতঃপর তোমার প্রতিপালক তাদের উপর শাস্তির চাবুক হানলেন
ayahs.meta_bn: সার্বিক ধ্বংসের কশাঘাত: শাস্তির তীব্র চাবুক দিয়ে অত্যাচারীদের মূলোৎপাটন
ayahs.meta_en: The Torrential Lash of Systemic Annihilation
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ص-ب-ব (ṣ-b-b): torrential pouring down; س-و-ط (s-w-ṭ): lashes/whip of physical catastrophe.

english_translations.pickthall: Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Therefore did thy Lord pour on them a scourge of diverse chastisements:
english_translations.shakir: Therefore your Lord let down upon them a portion of the chastisement.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Thus, your Lord afflicted them with torment;
english_translations.mohsin_khan: So your Lord poured on them different kinds of severe torment.
english_translations.arberry: Thy Lord unloosed on them a scourge of chastisement;

ayahs.translation_bn: তোমার প্রতিপালক অবশ্যই সতর্ক দৃষ্টি রাখছেন (যেমন ঘাঁটিতে শত্রুর প্রতি দৃষ্টি রাখা হয়)।
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
ayahs.conventional_en: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তোমার প্রতিপালক অবশ্যই সতর্ক দৃষ্টি রাখছেন (যেমন ঘাঁটিতে শত্রুর প্রতি দৃষ্টি রাখা হয়)।
ayahs.meta_bn: সতর্ক পর্যবেক্ষক প্রতিপালক: নিশ্চয়ই আপনার রব নিরন্তর সতর্ক দৃষ্টি রাখছেন
ayahs.meta_en: The Vigilant Watchtower: Your Lord Is in Constant Observation
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ر-ص-د (r-ṣ-d): watchful observation, uninterrupted systemic tracking.

english_translations.sahih_international: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
english_translations.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: For thy Lord is (as a Guardian) on a watch-tower.
english_translations.shakir: Most surely your Lord is watching.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: your Lord keeps an eye on (all evil-doing people).
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Verily, your Lord is Ever Watchful (over them).
english_translations.arberry: surely thy Lord is ever on the watch.

ayahs.transliteration: fa-ammā l-insānu idhā mā ib'talāhu rabbuhu fa-akramahu wanaʿʿamahu fayaqūlu rabbī akramani
ayahs.translation_bn: মানুষ এমন যে, তার প্রতিপালক যখন তাকে পরীক্ষা করেন সম্মান ও অনুগ্রহ দান ক’রে, তখন সে বলে, ‘আমার রব আমাকে সম্মানিত করেছেন।’
ayahs.translation_en: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
ayahs.conventional_en: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
ayahs.conventional_bn: মানুষ এমন যে, তার প্রতিপালক যখন তাকে পরীক্ষা করেন সম্মান ও অনুগ্রহ দান ক’রে, তখন সে বলে, ‘আমার রব আমাকে সম্মানিত করেছেন।’
ayahs.meta_bn: মানসিক ভ্রান্তি: পার্থিব সম্পদ ও প্রাচুর্যকে নিজের শ্রেষ্ঠত্বের মাপকাঠি ভাবা
ayahs.meta_en: Human Cognitive Fallacy: Equating Material Bounty with Intrinsic Honor
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ب-ل-و (b-l-w): testing through trial; superficial attribution of material privilege to intrinsic merit.

english_translations.sahih_international: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
english_translations.pickthall: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Now, as for man, when his Lord trieth him, giving him honour and gifts, then saith he, (puffed up), "My Lord hath honoured me."
english_translations.shakir: And as for man, when his Lord tries him, then treats him with honor and makes him lead an easy life, he says: My Lord honors me.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: As for the human being, when his Lord tests him, honors him, and grants him bounty, he says, "God has honored me".
english_translations.mohsin_khan: As for man, when his Lord tries him by giving him honour and gifts, then he says (puffed up): "My Lord has honoured me."
english_translations.arberry: As for man, whenever his Lord tries him, and honours him, and blesses him, then he says, 'My Lord has honoured me.'

ayahs.transliteration: wa-ammā idhā mā ib'talāhu faqadara ʿalayhi riz'qahu fayaqūlu rabbī ahānani
ayahs.translation_bn: আর যখন তিনি তাকে পরীক্ষা করেন তার রিযক সঙ্কুচিত ক’রে, তখন সে বলে, ‘আমার রব আমাকে লাঞ্ছিত করেছেন।’
ayahs.translation_en: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
ayahs.conventional_en: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যখন তিনি তাকে পরীক্ষা করেন তার রিযক সঙ্কুচিত ক’রে, তখন সে বলে, ‘আমার রব আমাকে লাঞ্ছিত করেছেন।’
ayahs.meta_bn: সংকীর্ণ দৃষ্টিভঙ্গি: জীবিকার সংকোচন ও পরীক্ষাকে লাঞ্ছনা মনে করার বিভ্রান্তি
ayahs.meta_en: The Petulant Fallacy: Equating Constrained Sustenance with Humiliation
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ق-د-ر (q-d-r): calibrating to minimal measure; psychological cognitive distortion equating poverty with divine disfavor.

english_translations.sahih_international: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
english_translations.pickthall: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: But when He trieth him, restricting his subsistence for him, then saith he (in despair), "My Lord hath humiliated me!"
english_translations.shakir: But when He tries him (differently), then straitens to him his means of subsistence, he says: My Lord has disgraced me.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: However, when his Lord tests him by a measured amount of sustenance, he says, "God has disgraced me".
english_translations.mohsin_khan: But when He tries him, by straitening his means of life, he says: "My Lord has humiliated me!"
english_translations.arberry: But when he tries him and stints for him his provision, then he says, 'My Lord has despised me.'

ayahs.translation_bn: না (রিযক) কক্ষনো (মান-সম্মানের মানদন্ড) নয়, বরং তোমরা ইয়াতীমের প্রতি সম্মানজনক আচরণ কর না,
ayahs.translation_en: No! But you do not honor the orphan
ayahs.conventional_en: No! But you do not honor the orphan
ayahs.conventional_bn: না (রিযক) কক্ষনো (মান-সম্মানের মানদন্ড) নয়, বরং তোমরা ইয়াতীমের প্রতি সম্মানজনক আচরণ কর না,
ayahs.meta_bn: সামাজিক দায়বদ্ধতাহীনতার অভিযোগ: অসহায় এতিমদের অবহেলা ও মর্যাদা না দেওয়া
ayahs.meta_en: Indictment: Neglect and Failure to Dignify the Vulnerable Orphan
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ك-ر-م (k-r-m): proactive dignity and welfare given to the defenseless.

english_translations.sahih_international: No! But you do not honor the orphan
english_translations.pickthall: Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Nay, nay! but ye honour not the orphans!
english_translations.shakir: Nay! but you do not honor the orphan,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Since wealth does not necessarily guarantee everlasting happiness) then why do you not show kindness to the orphans,
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Nay! But you treat not the orphans with kindness and generosity (i.e. you neither treat them well, nor give them their exact right of inheritance)!
english_translations.arberry: No indeed; but you honour not the orphan,

ayahs.translation_bn: আর তোমরা ইয়াতীম মিসকিনকে খাদ্য দেয়ার জন্য পরস্পরকে উৎসাহিত কর না,
ayahs.translation_en: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
ayahs.conventional_en: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তোমরা ইয়াতীম মিসকিনকে খাদ্য দেয়ার জন্য পরস্পরকে উৎসাহিত কর না,
ayahs.meta_bn: সামষ্টিক উদাসীনতা: অভাবী ও দুস্থদের অন্নদানে পরস্পরকে উৎসাহিত না করা
ayahs.meta_en: Systemic Indifference: Lack of Encouragement to Feed the Indigent
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ح-ض-ض (ḥ-ḍ-ḍ): mutual social mobilization for structural food security.

english_translations.sahih_international: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
english_translations.pickthall: And urge not on the feeding of the poor.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Nor do ye encourage one another to feed the poor!-
english_translations.shakir: Nor do you urge one another to feed the poor,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: or urge one another to feed the destitute?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And urge not on the feeding of AlMiskin (the poor)!
english_translations.arberry: and you urge not the feeding of the needy,

ayahs.translation_bn: আর তোমরা উত্তরাধিকারীদের সব সম্পদ খেয়ে ফেল।
ayahs.translation_en: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
ayahs.conventional_en: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তোমরা উত্তরাধিকারীদের সব সম্পদ খেয়ে ফেল।
ayahs.meta_bn: লুণ্ঠনমূলক লোভ: অন্যায়ভাবে অপরের উত্তরাধিকারের সম্পদ গ্রাস করা

english_translations.sahih_international: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
english_translations.pickthall: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed.

english_translations.shakir: And you eat away the heritage, devouring (everything) indiscriminately,
